title: Chapter 6997: Immortals Are Here

Chapter 6997: Immortals Are Here

Chapter 6997: Immortals Are Here

“Brat, that’s not funny. You made me waste good tea.” Mo Xiangsheng wiped his lips and glared at Li Qiye.

“I’m not joking, the source is right beneath us.” Li Qiye said.

“Really?” He paused and looked down skeptically.

“Indeed.” Li Qiye confirmed.

He activated his heavenly gaze and peered deep underground. Alas, he found nothing: “Brat, I don’t see anything.”

“How do you compare to Dusk?” Li Qiye asked.

“Should never be mentioned in the same sentence.” He said.

“Yes, and this is true even after his death. What makes you think you can detect the source?” Li Qiye smiled.

“True, that makes sense. If it were so easy, immortals would have found it already.” He clapped his thigh, realizing the reason.

“Wait...” He paused and said: “Then how do you know?”

“It’s obvious.” Li Qiye said.

“Obvious?” He stared at Li Qiye in confusion: “Don’t lie to me now.”

He stood up and staggered backward, realizing something was wrong. How could a mortal make it here faster than him, on top of detecting the source?

“Who are you?” He couldn’t help but ask.

“Just a mortal, what else can I be?” Li Qiye smiled.

“No, no, everything about you is off.” He said.

“Boom!” Suddenly, an immortal dao aura engulfed the dynasty, forcing all emperors and ancient ancestors to the ground.

“An immortal!” Mo Xiangsheng and Ye Fantian became alarmed.

“Oh, this is bad.” Mo Xiangsheng said.

“Who is in charge here? Come out to talk.” Someone spoke coldly.

Excitement replaced anxiety for Mo Xiangsheng upon hearing this voice.

“Senior, over here!” He waved.

“Pop!” The immortal arrived with an aura overwhelming the two overlords.

It turned out to be another familiar face - Till Ancestor.

“Why are you two here?” He frowned upon seeing them.

“I’m a guest.” Li Qiye said.

“Haha, fate brought us together again.” Mo Xiangsheng was glad it was a friendly immortal.

“Certainly not.” Till Ancestor said.

“A meeting right after our separation, only fate explains it.” Mo Xiangsheng smiled.

“I came after noticing a special aura here.” Till Ancestor said.

“Sounds like you haven’t found anything then.” Mo Xiangsheng laughed.

“Hmph.” Till Ancestor visited other visual phenomena to no avail. They were illusory and couldn’t be caught.

Therefore, he changed his mind about obtaining the source and court. More and more immortals have arrived, including those at the primordial stage.

Thus, he wanted other treasures instead. He noticed something special about Fantian Dynasty’s ancestral ground, hence his visit.

“Hehe, Senior, you came to the right place. I’ll let you know that the celestial source is right beneath our feet.” Mo Xiangsheng revealed.

“The celestial source? Ridiculous, it would have been taken long ago.” Till Ancestor uttered coldly.

“He’s the one who said it, ask him.” Mo Xiangsheng pointed at Li Qiye.

“Nonsense.” Till Ancestor said.

“He doesn’t believe you, want to try convincing him?” Mo Xiangsheng laughed.

“Everyone is free to believe what they want.” Li Qiye said.

Upon hearing this, Till Ancestor used his heavenly gaze. An immortal light delved into the ground.

“No source.” He concluded. However, he noticed something: “There’s something indistinct down there.”

“But not the source?” Mo Xiangsheng became anxious.

“Perhaps it is hiding something.” Till Ancestor scanned several more times.

Hiding something from him required a seal of the primordial level or greater. Therefore, he became hesitant about his conclusion.
